historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as a garage, auto repair shop 1, 3. Dated 1909–1910. Designed by Ward and Blohme as a private garage; it became the Alaska Garage, a public garage, in 1913. Brick-built, with a symmetrical façade.
The Alaska Garage, a public garage for fourteen years from 1913, run for most of them together with the Graystone Garage next door.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register.

building.completed_conflict: The 1990 unreinforced-masonry survey dates the building to 1910; the assessor's roll gives 1909.
